source_refs.note: Hadrons and Leptons: a main subheading of 12.5 Fundamental particles, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 269-271.

blocks.text: Particles ko un par lagne wali chaar fundamental forces ke hisaab se bhi baanta ja sakta hai. Gravity har particle par lagti hai magar sub-atomic level par is ka asar itna kam hai ke aam taur par isay ignore (nazar-andaz) kar dete hain. Electromagnetic force sab charged particles par lagti hai aur achhi tarah samjhi hui hai; zaroorat par isay shamil karte hain, magar is chapter mein zyada tar ignore karenge.

Bari classification is baat par hai ke particle strong force mehsoos karta hai ya nahi. Jo strong force mehsoos karte hain woh hadrons hain, aur jo nahi karte woh leptons. Hadrons ki misalein: protons, neutrons aur pions; leptons ki misalein: electrons aur neutrinos.

Hadrons composite (chhote hisson se bane) particles hain, jin ki do qismein hain: kuch bosons hain jinhein mesons kehte hain (maslan pion), aur kuch fermions hain jinhein baryons kehte hain (khaas misalein protons aur neutrons). Baryons odd (taaq: 1, 3, 5...) number ke quarks se bane hain (aam taur par teen), aur mesons even (juft: 2, 4...) number se (aam taur par do: ek quark aur ek antiquark).

blocks.alt: Tree (darakht) diagram: sab se oopar Particles; is se do branches (shakhein), Hadrons (strong force mehsoos karte hain) aur Leptons (strong force mehsoos nahi karte: electron, muon, tau aur un ke neutrinos). Hadrons ki do branches: Baryons (3 quarks: proton, neutron) aur Mesons (quark + antiquark: pion).

blocks.text: Leptons sirf weak ya electromagnetic forces se interact karte (asar daalte) hain. Koi experiment ab tak leptons ke andar koi structure nahi dhoond saka; yeh sach mein fundamental particles lagte hain jo toote nahi ja sakte. Tamam leptons ka spin ½ hai, is liye sab fermions hain. Chhe maloom leptons teen pairs mein hain (Table 12.3). Har pair mein ek charged particle (e⁻, μ⁻, τ⁻), us ka neutrino, aur in ke anti-particles hain. Charged leptons doosre particles ke saath mil kar atoms aur positronium jaise composite particles banate hain, jabke neutrinos kisi cheez se mushkil se interact karte hain, is liye bohat kam (rarely) dekhe jate hain. Sab se mashhoor lepton electron hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab charged leptons ko '(e⁻, m⁻, t⁻)' likhti hai; m aur t printing ki ghalti hai. Sahi symbols muon ke liye μ⁻ aur tau ke liye τ⁻ hain. Isi tarah Table 12.3 mein muon neutrino 'νₘ' chhapa hai, sahi ν_μ hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Table ko yun parhein: har family mein ek charged lepton (charge −1) aur us ka neutrino (charge 0) hai, aur har ek ka anti-particle ulte charge wala hai. Electron sab se halka (0.511 MeV/c²), muon taqreeban 207 guna aur tau taqreeban 3500 guna bhaari hai. Neutrinos ka mass bohat hi kam hai (1 eV, yani 10⁻⁶ MeV, se bhi kam); kitab ke sign '»' ka matlab yahan 'taqreeban/is se kam' samjhein.

items: Fundamental particle: koi internal structure nahi; quarks aur leptons. Zyada energy ki takkarein sau se zyada particles banati hain; strange particles pairs mein bante hain (π⁻ + p → K⁰ + Λ⁰).

Spin ½: fermions (Pauli exclusion); spin 0 ya 1: bosons (Bose-Einstein). Hadrons strong force mehsoos karte hain: baryons (3 quarks; p, n) aur mesons (quark + antiquark; pions). Leptons nahi karte: e, μ, τ aur un ke neutrinos (Table 12.3).
